web.description:
# Centrelink online account help - Deducting tax from your payment
Instructions on how to add, update or cancel voluntary deductions of tax from your eligible Centrelink payment using your Centrelink online account.

## in this guide
- [Step 4: cancel a tax amount for us to deduct](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/centrelink-online-account-help-deducting-tax-from-your-payment#step4)

You may have to pay tax if you get or will get any other taxable income in the tax year, for example income from employment. This guide will help you set up a voluntary tax amount we can deduct from your eligible Centrelink payment. We’ll send these tax amounts to the Australian Taxation Office (ATO).

The ATO will refund any tax amount we deduct from your payment that’s more than the tax you need to pay. You’ll get this at the end of the financial year.

## Step 2: add a tax amount to deduct
- [Step 4](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/centrelink-online-account-help-deducting-tax-from-your-payment#step4) to cancel your tax amount to deduct arrangement.

You can have other deductions in place. For example, you can have more than one Centrepay deduction but only one arrangement to deduct tax.

To set up a voluntary tax amount from your payment, select **Add deduction**.

Select **Begin**.

The next page will ask you to select what type of deduction you’d like to add. Select **Tax**, then select **Next**.

You can choose to deduct an amount or percentage of your payment.

To choose an amount to deduct, select **Have an amount deducted every fortnight** then select **Next**.

Enter the dollar amount you want deducted, then select **Next**.

To have a percentage deducted, select **Have a percentage of my taxable payment deducted** then select **Next**.

Enter the percentage you want deducted, then select **Next**.

![](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/sites/default/files/2026-03/coa-deducting-tax-from-payment-step2h.png)

Select **Continue**.

![](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/sites/default/files/2026-03/coa-deducting-tax-from-payment-step2i.png)
